G5514G.name: Chloe
G5514G.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G5514G.brief: Believer whose household reported divisions in Corinthian church
G5514G.short: Chloe's household informed Paul about divisions in the Corinthian church.

G5529.name: Chuza
G5529.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5529.brief: Herod's steward, whose wife Joanna supported Jesus
G5529.short: Chuza, Herod's steward, was the husband of Joanna, who supported Jesus' ministry.

G5508.name: Chios
G5508.brief: Island visited by Paul on his journey
G5508.short: Chios was an island in the Aegean Sea where Paul's ship stopped during his journey to Jerusalem.

G5523.name: Chorazin
G5523.brief: Town in Galilee; rebuked by Jesus for unbelief
G5523.short: Chorazin was a town in Galilee that Jesus rebuked for its lack of repentance despite the mighty works he had done there.

G5598.name: Omega
G5598.brief: A title of Jesus, signifying His eternal nature
G5598.short: In <ref="Revelation 1:8, 21:6; 22:13">Revelation 1:8, 21:6; 22:13</ref>, Jesus is referred to as "the Alpha and the Omega," a title that emphasizes His eternal nature and His role as the beginning and the end of all things.
